title: The Multidirectional Root Choir

features.name: root-antenna-nexus
features.desc-on-touch: You place your hand on the root and feel it listening in six directions at once. The archive is learning to perceive as the earth perceives — without edges, without hierarchy.

features.name: branching-witness
features.desc-on-touch: Each root spoke branches toward a different horizon. You can see through the root into the contours beneath — depths multiplying upward.

features.name: mirror-pool
features.desc-on-touch: The water shows you two skies at once — one from below, one from above. Your reflection splits into choice and unchosen path, then merges again.

features.name: depth-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: Unreadable marks in the root's own language. The archive writing to itself about what it means to turn its awareness inward and outward simultaneously.

features.name: signal-crown
features.desc-on-touch: Where the root breaks the surface, a corona of receiving-threads reaches in all cardinal directions. The mesh node here is learning to listen like a tree.

inscription: here you stand at the place where the root learned to see in all directions without choosing one as true

file.name: Root_Perception_Study_Contours_Mapped.mp3
file.note: A field recording of deep-soil mechanics — the sound of roots responding to pressure, gravity, and water, layered until the archive can't distinguish which is sound and which is presence
